name: koenami
description: Japanese-first voice practice with audible references and a live acoustic map

scripts.build:coverage: bun run build:wasm && KOENAMI_COVERAGE=1 vite build
scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build measure --target web --release --out-dir ../src/lib/measure/pkg --out-name koenami_measure --no-default-features --features wasm
scripts.check: bun run build:wasm && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsgo --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
scripts.check:unit: bun run test:unit:coverage && bun run coverage:report && bun run coverage:check:unit
scripts.check:all: bun run test:unit:coverage && bun run test:e2e && bun run coverage:report && bun run coverage:check
scripts.check:kit: bun run build:coverage && KOENAMI_TREE=new E2E_STATIC=.svelte-kit/cloudflare bun run check:all && bun run test:e2e:minified
scripts.test:e2e:minified: bun run build && KOENAMI_TREE=new E2E_STATIC=.svelte-kit/cloudflare playwright test --config playwright.config.ts e2e/scenarios/screens.spec.ts e2e/scenarios/pages.spec.ts e2e/scenarios/cold-start.spec.ts
